method: Independent accepted gameplay census, verified against retained HTML. Roster-dependent numeric effects and conditional rule-reference propagation are covered; battle-state execution is excluded.

records.title: Coordinated Exploitation
records.sourceText: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit

records.title: Exemplar of the Mont’ka
records.sourceText: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit during the fourth battle round as well

records.title: Exemplar of the Kauyon
records.sourceText: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding KROOT SHAPER models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third

records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting their Spotted unit

records.title: Borthrod Gland
records.sourceText: Kroot Flesh Shaper only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit

records.title: Nomadic Hunter
records.sourceText: KROOT TRAIL SHAPER model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability

records.title: Volley Fire
records.sourceText: Volley Fire: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: weapons equipped by models in that unit

records.title: Coldstar Commander
records.sourceText: Coldstar Commander: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12" and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12" and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability

records.title: Enforcer Commander
records.sourceText: Enforcer Commander: While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1

records.title: Failure Is Not an Option
records.sourceText: Failure Is Not an Option: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability

records.title: Ritual Butchery
records.sourceText: Ritual Butchery: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability

records.title: Rites of Feasting
records.sourceText: Rites of Feasting: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If that unit destroys one or more enemy units in the Fight phase, until the end of the battle, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability

records.title: Way of the Short Blade
records.sourceText: Way of the Short Blade: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", add 1 to the Wound roll.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", add 1 to the Wound roll

records.title: Structural Analyser
records.sourceText: Structural Analyser: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
records.requiredState: source or bearer leading attached unit
records.targetScope: that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll

negativePrerequisiteControls.sourceText: KROOT model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.
negativePrerequisiteControls.requiredState: none; unit/bearer scope expands with legal attachment, but no leading-only activation gate

excludedBattleStateRecords.sourceText: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
excludedBattleStateRecords.reason: Restriction on returning destroyed Character units during battle; this product does not execute resurrection or battle state.
